units.text: I made a Python check every hour, it compares expected and received readings per device. It showed 3 gateways had wrong clock setting. I fixed them and lost readings stayed under 0.5%.
I organised the yearly safety training day for 60 employees. I booked trainers and arranged the lunch for everybody.
I implemented over-the-air firmware updates with C for FreeRTOS sensor nodes. I used A/B partitions so failed update rolls back automatic. I rolled it out to 300 field sensors in 5 months.
